activity.title: Stage 03 class, JSON, Git, and unit-test evidence
activity.instructions:
This bounded activity maps to DotNet-React-Roadmap/3.md. It is a guided
learner-attestation task, not the complete Stage 03 gate.

Prerequisites: complete Stage01 and Stage02 in the learner sequence. Use
the .NET10 SDK, a C# editor, Git and a terminal. The unit-test template may
require package restore; an unavailable restore/tool is an incomplete task,
not evidence of a test pass.

Work in a clean learner-owned scratch folder and keep any personal data out
of the project. Start from a small console expense app. Separate the Expense
domain model, a service or rule boundary, a file store, and console/UI code
into named files. Preserve at least one invariant such as non-empty category
and non-negative amount; explain the boundary where that rule is enforced.

Add JSON persistence with System.Text.Json. Save a sample list, load it into
a fresh process or fresh in-memory state, and record the exact learner-chosen
input, file path, and observed count/category/amount result. Exercise a
missing file and malformed JSON path without overwriting the broken file;
record the actual error handling and whether the current list is preserved.

Create a separate test project beside the console project. Write and run at
least one meaningful unit test for a domain or service rule, including one
edge case such as empty category or negative amount. Record the exact test
command and observed result; do not invent a pass, failure, or output. Make
at least one small Git commit after a working slice and record the commit
subject and the relevant `git status`/`git diff` observation. If the SDK,
editor, Git, or test tooling is unavailable, leave the activity incomplete
and record the blocker.

The full-stage checks remain separate: id/date additions, CRUD menu behavior,
monthly totals, JSON round-trip, six unit tests, and the short README are not
claimed by this guided activity unless independently evidenced.
activity.expected_output: A learner evidence note with actual class/file boundaries, JSON save-load and error observations, a real unit-test record, and a Git history observation

rubric.evidence: The note identifies the Expense invariant and shows separate domain, service/rule, file-store, and UI responsibilities with concrete files or code boundaries.
The note records an actual save-load round trip plus missing-file and malformed-JSON behavior, including whether broken data was preserved; no output is fabricated.
The note contains an actual unit-test command/result for a meaningful rule and a real Git commit/status or diff observation; unavailable tooling remains incomplete.
